audience: home coffee beginners who own basic gear
description: 22-second talking-head plus b-roll: creator claims the moka pot 'burnt taste' is a heat problem, shows the fix (pre-boiled water, low flame, pull early), ends on a side-by-side taste reaction.
hook_summary: 0.0s close-up of a sputtering moka pot with on-screen text 'You're burning it' while the first words are 'Your moka pot isn't bad, you are'.

reasons.stop_power: Motion and sound from frame one, readable 3-word text, a direct challenge in the first sentence. No intro. Loses half a point because the first frame is dark.
reasons.hold: Three clear steps keep it moving and the taste test is held to the end, but the middle b-roll runs 6 seconds with no new information.
reasons.share_save: Useful and specific enough to save, and easy to send to 'that friend with the moka pot'. Low emotional charge.
reasons.comment_trigger: The 'you are the problem' framing and the low-flame claim invite disagreement and personal methods.
reasons.rewatch_loop: Linear payoff, no loop, nothing dense enough to need a second pass.
reasons.audience_fit: Squarely the account's niche; gear the audience already owns; vertical, native look, captions on.

context.notes: Moka pot 'fix' videos from two mid-size creators did well in the past month; the angle itself is common.
sources: (example) platform search for 'moka pot burnt', sorted by recent

blind_spots: sound choice unknown: judged on voice track only

fixes.change: Cut the 6-second b-roll at 0:09 to 2 seconds or put step text over it
Brighten or swap the first frame so the pot reads at thumb-scroll speed
